note: Stage B: every realm.json bakes foreignSea + clipTarns into fieldsA (fields.fieldsA.baked, else fieldsA.baked), so ground.js load() runs neither and the loaded fieldsA is the file byte for byte, whichever mask (packVsCatalog: 0 texels, 0 vertices, computed). Per realm the border is the deeds where the pack mask and the catalogue differ (maskDeeds), plus the deeds a cap re-run with the catalogue far field would move (reRun.fieldDeeds); at each, 14 × 14 vertices (x = dx·98 + 3 + 7i, y = dy·98 + 3 + 7j, row-major) classified with the realm config (true) and latticeCfg (lattice) on the LOADED fields, no plots. fieldsA.crops = the loaded (= file) bytes over every border deed ± 1; fieldsBC.crops = left halves then right halves. reRun = classify.js foreignSeaRows run again over the baked bytes with the catalogue far field (a loader that ignores the flag): the coast texels, deeds and border vertices it moves (the teeth: honouring the flag is observable); reRun.packCoastTexels = the same re-run with the pack far field (0: the cap is idempotent on its own output). The far field stays per mask (farCatalog vs packVsCatalog.farDeeds).
tolerance: exact: the catalogue mask, the far field (float32 bits), the post-load fieldsA bytes and every vertex class, ground class, ring flag and sampled wetness
